snippet.title: TRUCK DRIVER: THE DUTCH CONNECTION - Official Reveal TRAILER (2025)
snippet.description:
#TruckDriver #Soedesco #TruckGame2025
Get ready to hit the road in the next evolution of the beloved Truck Driver series from SOEDESCO! Explore the Netherlands like never before in Truck Driver: The Dutch Connection, featuring stunning next-gen visuals, realistic physics, and an all-new storyline.

Whislist now:
🔵PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015677
🟢Xbox Series X/S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/truck-driver-the-dutch-connection/9N29Q5L857JV

🚛 Key Features:
• Dutch landscapes and cities
• Deep story mode with dynamic contracts
• Customizable trucks and advanced tuning options

Whether you’re a veteran hauler or new to truck sims, this is the ultimate open-world driving experience.

📅 Release Date: 2025
📍 Platforms: PlayStation, Xbox, PC

#TruckDriver #Soedesco #TruckGame2025 #TheDutchConnection #Simulation #DrivingGame

Follow SOEDESCO®!
Discord: https://discord.gg/soedesco
Website: http://www.soedesco.com/
Newsletter: https://bit.ly/2wsfR4f
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Soedesco
Twitter: https://twitter.com/soedesco
Instagram: https://instagram.com/soedesco

Video editors: 
@DanielFigaresYT 
@juanfranrivero

About SOEDESCO:
SOEDESCO is an independent video game developer, publisher, and distributor founded in 2002 by Soedesh Chauthi with its headquarters in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, and offices in Madrid, Spain & Pilsen, Czech Republic. We deliver creative content across multiple genres and platforms for a worldwide audience in physical and digital formats.
